in_sanskrit.name: Sharvikaasya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharvikaasya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Goddess of wealth and prosperity in Hindu mythology. She is often depicted as a golden-skinned woman with multiple arms, holding a lotus and a gold coin. Sharvikaasya is also known as Lakshmi, the goddess of abundance and good fortune.
